anyOf.$comment: forbidden Realm authorship field; canonical name is created_by
forbidden Realm addressing field; the only alias carrier is the ak.realm.alias Event (realm_alias). See zh/discovery/object-addressing.md section 3.3.
forbidden Realm policy field; the only carrier is the ak.realm.plaintext_visible_services facet typed current result. See zh/sync/service-surface.md.

id.description: Present on the materialised object. MUST be absent from the create Event payload: zh/models/common-fields.md derives it from the create Event's own event_id (retyped), so a payload-supplied id would be a second, forgeable truth.

security_class.description: Optional security class. 'high_assurance' forbids federation_policy=open and SHOULD use stricter resolver/E2EE/audit defaults. Omitted = 'standard'.

trust_domain.description: Immutable deployment trust domain captured by ak.realm.create. Receivers MUST require this to match the current Realm trust domain before accepting cross-domain replay-sensitive proofs.

owning_organization_ids.description: Declared or projected stable Organization principal identities associated with this Realm. Each value is a did_core_id and is not itself resolvable DID material; Organization classification and current DID evidence are established by accepted registration/resolution state. This field alone is not a verified ownership/governance endorsement; clients and directories MUST require an active ak.realm.organization statement for verified badges or organization-controlled semantics.

schema_refs.description: Create-locked union of registered schema ids and the closed Realm structural-role profile allowlist. Policy, deployment conformance and operation-local profiles are forbidden here.

fields.description: Product/profile fields. Security-relevant discriminators such as purpose in {principal_control, agent_control} and collaboration_role=direct_conversation are schema constrained below; other product fields remain extension-defined.

preview_policy_id.description: Optional materialized pointer to the effective preview / peek policy. Canonical writes use ak.realm.preview_policy; absence means directory card / stripped state only, no history stub/snippet preview.

default_strand_id.description: Derived ordinary default-Strand selection from current-value projection realm_set_default_strand. The deterministic (depth, EventId) winner selects the candidate; it is effective only when the selected Strand is eligible, non-terminal, and in the same Realm. Selection grants no authority.

history_access.description: Scope-local history range ratchet initialized by Realm create. Only all_history_for_current_members to since_join may change state; widening back to all_history is permanently forbidden. Standard MLS requires since_join.

governance_station_id.description: Current governance Station service identity, derived from generation-0 genesis and the verified consecutive handoff chain. It is the authority that signs RealmCommit records for every independent Realm, Circle, and Sidecar stream in this Realm generation.

agent_participation.description: Realm five-bit Agent participation ceiling. It may only tighten the target-service safety ceiling and is itself the parent of Circle and Strand ceilings.

availability_policy.description: Realm policy component governing independently signed byte-availability receipts before RealmCommit inclusion and before snapshot/backfill availability claims. Eligible holders are derived only from routing service IDs projected from effective joined-member ActorIds frozen at the predecessor view. The policy never creates an out-of-membership replication target. Absent means {min_holders:1,applies_to:['commit_include'],minimum_retention_ms:86400000}.

digest_algorithm.description: Digest suite (canonicalization x hash tuple) used for Event ids, Event ids, RealmCommit ids, state_root, and Merkle leaves within this Realm. It is locked at create except for ak.realm.digest_suite_transition under ak.profile.hash_transition.v1. Defaults to sha256. Value space is the active rows of artifacts/registry/digest-suite-registry.json (this enum MUST be regenerated when a row flips active, e.g. cbor.sha256); bare ids denote canonical-JSON canonicalization, dotted ids denote alternate canonical encodings. Exactly one live suite per Realm; valid delayed Events retain the suite of their signed authority context. Transition uses the control-plane transition Event and dual-root RealmCommit defined by event-auth-state-resolution.md §13.

commit_compaction_max_interval_ms.description: Optional operational reminder for compacting an actively advancing safety log. It never requires an idle RealmCommit, expires an accepted authority reference, or gates ordinary data. Existing verified snapshots and proofs remain reusable while signers are offline.

max_authority_lifetime_ms.description: Maximum fixed child-chain lifetime only for actions explicitly required to be finite by their risk/constraint contract. Defaults to 24 hours for those actions; first use freezes the bound and redelegation cannot renew it. It does not impose expiry on unbounded ordinary chat/read/organizer authorization.

allOf.$comment: Principal Control and Direct Conversation are mutually exclusive Realm roles.
